_comment: Price table for LAC-4124 pricing measurement. USD per million tokens.
_verified: 2026-10-16, fetched from live provider docs, not from a cached model catalog (LAC-3106).

_schema.cache_read: cache hits and refreshes, per MTok
_schema.long_context_threshold: optional; prompt tokens above this switch to the long_* rates
_schema.billing: metered = per-token API billing; subscription = flat-rate seat, no marginal token cost

_notes: Anthropic usage reports input_tokens EXCLUDING cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens, so summing all four categories does not double-count.
OpenAI reports no separate cache-write charge; cache_write is 0 and cached_tokens bill at the cache_read rate.
gpt-5.5 above 272K input tokens moves to a long-context tier not published in the short-context table; long_* rates are intentionally absent so the analyzer fails loudly rather than guessing.
Claude CLI models are billed as a Claude Max/Pro seat, not per token. Marginal cost to Juno is zero; the analyzer reports them separately instead of as $0.00 alongside metered models.

Opus 5.5 computer use requires computer_toolset_20260801, which roughly doubles per-request input overhead (4,530 vs 2,152 tokens, measured 2026-09-22). That overhead is already inside the reported input_tokens; do not add it again.
